Anova test
```{r}
compute.anova.test = function(data, coldata, trait, pval = 0.05){

  sig = c()
  coldata[,trait] = as.factor(coldata[,trait])

  for (j in 1:ncol(data)) {
    df = data.frame("Value" = data[,j], "Trait" = coldata[,trait])

    # skip if feature is constant
    if (length(unique(df$Value)) < 2) next

    # try ANOVA safely
    res.aov <- tryCatch({
      df %>% rstatix::anova_test(Value ~ Trait)
    }, error = function(e) NULL)

    if(!is.null(res.aov)){
      if(round(res.aov$p, 5) <= pval){
        sig = c(sig, j)
      }
    }
  }

  features_sig = data[,sig, drop = FALSE]

  if(length(sig)==0){
    message("No significant features (pvalue < ", pval, ") after Anova test")
    return(NULL)
  } else {
    return(features_sig)
  }
}
```

```{r}
minMax <- function(x) {
  #columns: features
  x = data.matrix(x)
  for(i in 1:ncol(x)){
    x[,i] = (x[,i] - min(x[,i], na.rm = T)) / (max(x[,i], na.rm = T) - min(x[,i], na.rm = T))
  }

  return(x)

}
```

DEG analysis
```{r}
library(DESeq2)

# Make a new factor where all non-A are merged into "rest"
coldata$group_1 <- factor(ifelse(coldata$Groups == 1, 1, "rest"))
dds_A <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(round(counts), coldata, design = ~ group_1)

res_A <- results(dds_A, contrast = c("group_1", 1, "rest"))

# Repeat for group B
coldata$group_2 <- factor(ifelse(coldata$Groups == 2, 2, "rest"))
dds_B <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(round(counts), coldata, design = ~ group_2)
dds_B <- DESeq(dds_B)
res_B <- results(dds_B, contrast = c("group_2", 2, "rest"))

# Repeat for group C
coldata$group_4 <- factor(ifelse(coldata$Groups == 4, 4, "rest"))
dds_C <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(round(counts), coldata, design = ~ group_4)
dds_C <- DESeq(dds_C)
res_C <- results(dds_C, contrast = c("group_4", 4, "rest"))

### Group 2 vs 4
dds_D <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(round(counts), coldata, design = ~ Groups)
dds_D <- DESeq(dds_D)
res_D <- results(dds_D, contrast = c("Groups", 2, 4))
```

Volcano plots
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

# Volcano plot with labels
plot_volcano <- function(res, group_name, lfc_thresh = 1.5, padj_thresh = 0.05) {
  
  res <- as.data.frame(res)
  
  res$Significance <- "Not Significant"
  res$Significance[res$log2FoldChange >  lfc_thresh & res$padj < padj_thresh] <- "Up in group"
  res$Significance[res$log2FoldChange < -lfc_thresh & res$padj < padj_thresh] <- "Up in rest"
  
  ggplot(res, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj), color = Significance)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Up in group" = "red", 
                                  "Up in rest" = "blue", 
                                  "Not Significant" = "grey")) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc_thresh, lfc_thresh), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(padj_thresh), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = subset(res, padj < padj_thresh & abs(log2FoldChange) > lfc_thresh) %>%
        tibble::rownames_to_column("gene"),
      aes(label = gene),
      size = 3,
      max.overlaps = 15
    ) +
    labs(title = paste0("Volcano Plot: ", group_name, " vs Rest"),
         x = "log2 Fold Change",
         y = "-log10 adjusted p-value") +
    theme_minimal()
}

p_A <- plot_volcano(as.data.frame(res_A), "Group 1")
p_B <- plot_volcano(as.data.frame(res_B), "Group 2")
p_C <- plot_volcano(as.data.frame(res_C), "Group 4")
p_D <- plot_volcano(as.data.frame(res_D), "Group 2 vs 4")

p_A
p_B
p_C
```

DEG signatures
```{r}
# Function to extract markers for the group
extract_markers <- function(res, lfc_thresh = 1, padj_thresh = 0.05) {
  res <- as.data.frame(res) %>% 
    tibble::rownames_to_column("gene")
  
  subset(res, log2FoldChange > lfc_thresh & padj < padj_thresh)$gene
}

# Markers for each group
markers_group1 <- extract_markers(res_A) # Genes up in Group A
markers_group2 <- extract_markers(res_B) # Genes up in Group B
markers_group4 <- extract_markers(res_C) # Genes up in Group C

# Pairwise 2 vs 4 (only up in 2)
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(round(counts), coldata, design = ~ Groups)
dds <- DESeq(dds)
res_4v2 <- results(dds, contrast = c("Groups", "4", "2"))
markers_4v2 <- as.data.frame(res_4v2) %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  filter(log2FoldChange > 1.0 & padj < 0.05) %>%
  pull(gene)

# Create gene set list
gene_sets <- list(
  Group1_markers = markers_group1,
  Group2_markers = markers_group2,
  Group4_markers = markers_group4,
  Group4vs2_markers = markers_4v2
)

```

```{r}
compute.survival.analysis = function(data, value_name, survival.data, time_unit, file_name) {
  library(survival)
  library(survminer)
  
  # Example: using Group2vs4_markers score as continuous predictor
  data_for_model <- data.frame(
    time   = survival.data$PFS,
    status = survival.data$PFS_event,
    score  = data[,value_name]
  )
  
  # Cox PH model with continuous score
  cox_model <- coxph(Surv(time, status) ~ score, data = data_for_model)
  summary_cox <- summary(cox_model)
  
  hr  <- summary_cox$coef[1, "exp(coef)"]    # hazard ratio
  pval <- summary_cox$coef[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]    # p-value
  
  message("Cox PH model: HR = ", round(hr, 3), 
          " (95% CI ", round(summary_cox$conf.int[1,3], 3), "-", 
                         round(summary_cox$conf.int[1,4], 3), 
          "), p = ", signif(pval, 3))
  
  # Dichotomize only for visualization (median split)
  data_for_model$group <- ifelse(data_for_model$score >= median(data_for_model$score, na.rm=TRUE),
                                 "High", "Low")
  km_fit <- survfit(Surv(time, status) ~ group, data = data_for_model)
  
  # KM plot without log-rank p-value, only Cox PH in subtitle
  pdf(paste0("Results/SurvPlot_DEG_groups_", file_name), width = 10, height = 5, onefile = FALSE)
  print(
    ggsurvplot(
      km_fit, data = data_for_model,
      pval = FALSE,  # remove log-rank test
      risk.table = TRUE,
      risk.table.col = "strata",
      size = 1,
      conf.int = FALSE,
      legend.labs = c("Low score", "High score"),
      ggtheme = theme_minimal(),
      title = paste0("Survival by DEG signature score (", time_unit, ")"),
      xlab = paste0("Time to death/recurrence/progression (", time_unit, ")"),
      subtitle = paste0("Cox PH (continuous): HR=", round(hr,3), ", p=", signif(pval,3))
    )
  )
  dev.off()
  
  return(list(cox_model = cox_model, hr = hr, pval = pval))
}

```
